title: The Pan-Erotic Artistic Temple
content: Something I saw at mall world a Few weeks ago and has stuck with me. The entrance was on the exterior and had a big neon marquis which is why I remember the name, the art was arguably not erotic unless you are into screen-prints of bamboo on tile floors or dryads in that way, and it was semi religious. I know it’s a long-shot, but has anyone else come across museums or temples in the mall? What were they like?
